progression_rule: All sets are 45 s of work. When you get through all 3 rounds with good form and it feels like about 7 out of 10 for two sessions of the same day in a row, go up one step next time: dumbbells +1 kg each hand, kettlebell +2 kg, cable one plate (about 2.5 kg). Bodyweight moves get harder instead: press-ups on a lower bench, a lighter band for chin-ups, sit-ups with the bench one notch steeper. If a set feels like 9 out of 10 or you can't make the 45 s, stay where you are. Sessions 16-18: easier week, 2 rounds instead of 3. Poor sleep, a big work day or feeling run down: do 2 rounds and keep the weights. Right knee: do the full warm-up and go a little lighter on the first round; it should settle. If it doesn't settle, or you get sharp pain, swap the leg move and see a GP or physio. Cardio (treadmill, bike or walk, about 30 min on off days) gets logged separately.

days.name: Day A - Lunge, Press, Sit-up, Row
days.warmup: 3 min easy bike or treadmill. 10 glute bridges, 10 bodyweight box squats, 8 slow reverse lunges each leg with no weight, 10 Y raises lying face down (no weight).

exercises.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
exercises.notes: Alternate legs. Step back long, back knee toward the floor, push up through the front heel.

exercises.name: Bench-elevated press-up
exercises.notes: Body in one line, chest to the bench edge. Lower the bench when it gets easy.

exercises.name: Incline-bench sit-up
exercises.notes: Slow on the way down. Arms crossed, or hold a light plate when it's easy.

exercises.name: Standing one-arm cable row
exercises.notes: About 22 s each arm. Stand tall, pull the elbow back past the ribs.

days.name: Day B - Hinge, Pull, Squat, Posture
days.warmup: 3 min easy bike or treadmill. 10 glute bridges, 10 hip hinges with hands on hips, 10 bodyweight box squats, 20 s dead hang.

exercises.name: Kettlebell deadlift
exercises.notes: Hips back, flat back, stand tall and squeeze the glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Band-assisted chin-up
exercises.notes: Bar with a band, or feet on the floor. Slow on the way down. Rest at the top or bottom as needed within the 45 s.

exercises.name: Goblet squat to bench
exercises.notes: Hold the kettlebell at the chest, sit back to touch the bench, stand tall. The big leg move for this day.

exercises.name: Cable rope face pull (both ropes)
exercises.notes: Pull to the eyebrows, thumbs back, squeeze the shoulder blades. Posture work.
